records.rule: Do not detect SETMETHOD entries by sending INDEX or HASINDEX: the entry's method runs. Detect object state by calibrated field offsets read without sending messages.
FORWARD inside a ::ROUTINE helper raises 98.947; a helper that re-sends a message uses sendWith.
An activation takes its package's security manager when it starts. Setting a manager mid-routine does not cover that routine's own calls or commands.
Helper routines must not use dot symbols (.context, .local): each is a LOCAL request the user's security manager would see. Use RX2CPP_CALLER_CONTEXT and RX2CPP_TAKE.
An object's string value is REQUEST('STRING') first, then STRING with NOSTRING (RexxInternalObject::requestString); calling STRING twice printed an extra NOMETHOD message.

records.topic: first read of a method entry
records.rule: FindClass on a name whose .environment entry is a SETMETHOD method runs it; look classes up in the package's own class directories first (packageClass).
Delete previous output before comparing: an old dump file gave a false IDENTICAL.
Large generated libraries (Rexx Parser) need the machine to themselves: cc1plus was OOM-killed beside other builds.
Check ooRexx trunk before writing an interpreter ticket: bug 5 had been fixed in r13259.
RexxThreadInterface ends with four object fields (RexxNil, RexxTrue, RexxFalse, RexxNullString); the size assert counts them.
A source file ending in a lone CR (the Rexx Parser's Elements.cls) needs a final LF added when copied for a build.
